text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is here, but… Maruzensky is not.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I see just a flicker of hesitation in Grass Wonder's eyes, and then she's back to acting her prim, practiced self.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well, now that all the preparations are complete, it's about time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I glance at her feet and notice she has her training shoes on.
choice_data_list: Shouldn't you change into your racing cleats?
Shouldn't you change into your racing cleats?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: M-my apologies. I'll put them on right away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Without Maruzensky's footsteps to follow, Grass Wonder looks unsure where to go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even so, the crowd roars—for the gates must open, and the Arima Kinen must go on.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hello there, Sei. How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Decent, I guess? Same old, same old.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. So you're in peak condition, then.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I should be off as well.
